actions.classic_fallback: every governed step keeps its classic driver as the fallback oracle and the A4_CLASSIC=1 opt-out re-points the seal at it; rollback = remove the seal markers or run with A4_CLASSIC=1
actions.fail_loud: a changed input claimed by no slice, an owned input claimed by two slices of one generator, or drift differing from the declared set stops the run BEFORE any output byte is written
actions.generated_drivers: sliced drivers are GENERATED from the then-current classic by a4-make-driver.py (anchors asserted) — never hand-copied; a classic that moved since the last derivation regenerates or the batch stops
actions.slice_fingerprint: each slice carries a fingerprint over its owned + shared inputs including the driver code hash; the fingerprint is the skip/rebuild authority — a slice rebuilds only when its fingerprint moved
actions.splice_from_cache: unchanged slices' pre-serialized values splice into the prior output through the classic assembly code, unchanged; no cached value is re-serialized at merge time

rule: A builder is GOVERNED by this step when its emit is per-page or per-cell (one slice per registry page / per service) and the classic build recomputes every slice on every run. A governed builder may not run slice-scoped in a production seal until its sliced driver carries a rig proof recorded here: cold sliced build byte-identical to the classic on the same tree, the three plant shapes, and the fail-loud breaks (uncovered change, double-claim, undeclared drift). Any later edit to a governed sliced driver changes its sha256 and the A1.8 gate goes RED until a fresh proof is recorded. The classic seat stays byte-untouched as the fallback oracle; A4_CLASSIC=1 re-points every governed step at it.

slice_map.rule: the production slice map is generated from data/pages.json + data/services.json + rubric.db metadata — never hand-listed; the A1.8 gate re-builds it dry and requires the partition check (no owned input claimed twice within a generator) and full registry coverage (every page an AE + search-index + page-data slice, every service a coverage slice)
